question: Where’s the closest hospital when heading west from Rolling Hills Asylum, East Bethany, NY?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rolling Hills Asylum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%East Bethany%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, origin AS o WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 -- Filter for west direction (247.5 to 292.5 degrees) ORDER BY ST_Distance(o.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
